index: Retail Price Index, all items, base July 2018 = 100, Barbados Statistical Service
note: February 2021 wasn't collected (the pandemic's restrictions), so 2021's mean is of its eleven other months, as the Service's own annual average (102.8) is; 2025's is the Service's 113.2.

sources.title: Barbados Statistical Service, Retail Price Index, December 2025 (Base: July 2018=100)
sources.said: Point to Point Percentage Change in the All Items Index ... 2021: January 101.8, February NA, March 101.9, April 102.0, May 101.6, June 102.0, July 102.6, August 103.4, September 103.6, October 103.8, November 104.0, December 104.1, Annual Averages 102.8 ... 2025: January 112.1, February 112.2, March 112.6, April 112.3, May 112.6, June 113.4, July 113.5, August 113.7, September 113.6, October 114.0, November 114.2, December 113.8, Annual Averages 113.2 ... due to restrictions put in place during April 2020 and February 2021 to manage the COVID 19 pandemic, the collections for these months could not be completed. As a result, the indices for April 2020 and February 2021 could not be calculated.
